1.explanation:
• NumberInput/NumberInput.mdx – the primary component doc that will need a new readOnly prop and examples
• NumberInput/docs/overview.mdx – the style and usage guide showing sizing, spacing and token values used by NumberInput (to match the mockups)
• NumberInput/migrate-to-7.x.md – migration notes may need to mention the new readOnly prop if upgrading from an earlier version
• TextInput/TextInput.mdx and TextInput/docs/overview.mdx – reference implementation for how TextInput implements and documents a readOnly prop, styles and stories
• TextInput/migrate-to-7.x.md – to see how a migration guide mentions readOnly and to mirror that in the NumberInput guide

Together these documents provide the design specs, usage patterns, token values and migration examples needed to implement, document and test the new read-only state for NumberInput.
1.bug_scenario: The report highlights that the NumberInput component doesn’t yet support a read-only variant. The provided mockups show the visual requirements for read-only in three sizes (small, medium, large) with exact stroke widths, icon sizes, spacing and color/token values for label, helper text, placeholder, borders and disabled icons. The scenario involves a disabled‐looking text field with “–” and “+” icons that cannot be interacted with and a read-only styling class applied to the input container.
